children: Overview
Pharmacy provider's consolidated H1 operating revenue rose 8.8% to NZ$197.7 mln
Net profit attributable to shareholders rose 2,638.5% to NZ$196.7 mln
Company completed the sale of its Medical division on July 31
Outlook
Green Cross Health expects an initial distribution of significant Medical sale proceeds by mid-2027
Sees H2 work progressing to align support functions and infrastructure with future growth
Result Drivers
MEDICAL DIVESTMENT – Sale of the Medical division generated an NZ$188.1 mln gain, while net profit attributable to shareholders was NZ$196.7 mln versus NZ$7.2 mln a year earlier
RETAIL EXECUTION – Co said retail performance was reinforced by targeted promotions, Beauty Week and Living Rewards initiatives that lifted engagement and basket size
DISPENSARY MIX PRESSURE – Co said a shift toward high-value, low-margin medicines, including funded cancer medications, continued to pressure dispensary margins
DIGITAL APPOINTMENTS – More than 75,000 appointments were booked through the new pharmacy app and integrated booking platform during the period
